rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion assignment to himself or to Kagan to craft a narrow, administrable rule harmonizing § 1252(a)(2)(D) with Patel by permitting review only for legal misapplication of the hardship standard on agency-found facts. One or both dissenters may write to argue the hardship inquiry is an unreviewable degree-laden judgment, while a few in the majority may add concurrences to emphasize the tight limits against reweighing evidence.
